title: The impact of site-specific digital histology signatures on deep learning model accuracy and bias
main_findings: Models can identify submitting sites despite color normalization and augmentation.
limitations: TCGA observations do not identify the mechanism of SMC source confounding.
Review covers the cited pages; quantitative tables require further source verification.
does_not_establish: No proof of shortcut magnitude or causal mechanism in SMC.
relevance_to_project: Motivates Exp3-only and acquisition metadata controls.
